moat.overall_moat_verdict_en: The company operates in the biopharmaceutical sector, which inherently has high barriers to entry due to regulatory hurdles and R&D intensity. Its flagship product, Guyoudao, holds a significant market share and was a pioneer in its category in China, suggesting a strong brand and regulatory advantage. The company's long operating history and inclusion of products in national procurement programs indicate some level of established presence and customer stickiness. However, the broader biopharmaceutical market is highly competitive, and reliance on centralized procurement can exert pricing pressure. stock.description: Hangzhou Jiuyuan Genetic Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and commercialization of biopharmaceutical products and medical devices in Mainland China and internationally. The company offers Guyoudao, a bone repair material; Jilifen, a human granulocyte colony stimulating factor injection; Jijufen, a human interleukin-11 injection; Jiouting, a palonosetron hydrochloride injection; Jifuwei, a fulvestrant injection; Jitansu, a fosaprepitant dimeglumine injection; and Jixinfen, PEG-GCSF injection. It also provides Jilixin avatrombopag maleate tablets; Jipailin, a low molecular weight heparin sodium injection; and Yinuojia, an enoxaparin sodium injection. The company was formerly known as Hangzhou Jiuyuan Gene Engineering Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Hangzhou Jiuyuan Genetic Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. in April 2025. Hangzhou Jiuyuan Genetic Biopharmaceutical Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.

stock.description_zh: 杭州九源基因生物製藥有限公司是一家生物製藥公司，在中國大陸及國際上從事生物製藥產品和醫療器械的研發、製造和商業化。該公司提供骨優導（一種骨修復材料）、吉粒芬（人粒細胞集落刺激因子注射液）、吉巨芬（人白細胞介素-注射液）、九亭（帕洛諾司瓊鹽酸鹽注射液）、吉福韋（氟維司瓊注射液）、吉坦素（磷酸阿瑞匹坦二葡甲胺注射液）和吉欣芬（聚乙二醇化重組人粒細胞集落刺激因子注射液）。它還提供吉利欣阿伐曲泊帕馬來酸片、吉派林（低分子肝素鈉注射液）和依諾佳（依諾肝素鈉注射液）。該公司前身為杭州九源基因工程有限公司，並於二零二五年四月更名為杭州九源基因生物製藥有限公司。杭州九源基因生物製藥有限公司於一九九三年成立，總部位於中國杭州。
